svg.title: Wilkinson divider (2.4 GHz) — technical drawing
svg.desc: Wilkinson divider (2.4 GHz) (wilkinson-divider) · Fairbeam 0.1.0 · third-angle projection

g.text: 3. Metal parts are PEC; zero-thickness sheets are drawn with a minimum line width (solid black when seen edge-on).
4. P1: lumped port, 50 Ω, along z, gap 1.898 mm, excited.
5. P2: lumped port, 50 Ω, along z, gap 1.898 mm.
6. P3: lumped port, 50 Ω, along z, gap 1.898 mm.
7. Isolation resistor 100 ohm: 100 Ω resistor, current along y.
